method: read the delegation seam and exercise the per-invocation tracker in isolation; assert the ownership rules and the optionality contract

ownership.hostLocalJobId: the delegation service own ephemeral job id; empty string on the blocking path that has none
ownership.invocationId: the port observation, adopted verbatim, never minted here
ownership.dshSessionId: the port observed identity, never derived from a payload

asyncPath.hostLocalJobId: the service own wdj-<uuid> job id

optionality: the wrapper returns undefined when no sink is attached, so the run input stays byte-identical to the baseline
failureContainment: a throwing consumer is swallowed; settlement authority is untouched
expectedInvariant: each identity comes from its own owner, and the correlation introduces no settlement or promotion authority
